ko.title: PCE와 고용 보고서: 연준의 다음 행보를 결정할 두 가지 지표

segments.src: Two of the most closely watched economic releases of the year arrive within days of each other.
segments.tr: 올해 가장 주목받는 경제 지표 두 가지가 며칠 간격으로 발표됩니다.

segments.src: The Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, and the September jobs report will both be published this week.
segments.tr: 미 연방준비제도(Fed·연준)가 가장 선호하는 인플레이션 지표인 개인소비지출(PCE) 가격지수와 9월 고용 보고서가 이번 주에 모두 발표될 예정입니다.

segments.src: Together they give investors, businesses and households their clearest look yet at whether the central bank is likely to keep raising interest rates into the new year or to hold steady.
segments.tr: 이 두 지표는 투자자, 기업, 가계가 중앙은행이 내년에도 금리 인상을 이어갈지, 아니면 현 수준을 유지할지 판단할 수 있는 가장 명확한 단서를 제공합니다.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only.
segments.tr: *본 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공만을 목적으로 합니다.

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or financial advice.*
segments.tr: 투자, 세금 또는 재무 관련 조언이 아닙.*

segments.src: ## Why These Two Reports Matter Together
segments.tr: ## 왜 이 두 보고서가 함께 중요한가

segments.src: The Fed has a dual mandate: stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: 연준은 물가 안정과 최대 고용이라는 이중 책무를 가지고 있습니다.

segments.src: Each report speaks to one half of it.
segments.tr: 각 보고서는 이 중 한 가지 측면을 보여줍니다.

segments.src: - **PCE inflation** shows whether price pressures are cooling toward the Fed's 2% target.
segments.tr: - **PCE 인플레이션**은 물가 압력이 연준의 목표치인 2%를 향해 둔화하고 있는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: - **Nonfarm payrolls** show whether the labor market is still running hot enough to keep wages and spending elevated.
segments.tr: - **비농업 부문 고용**은 노동 시장이 임금과 소비를 높게 유지할 만큼 여전히 과열되어 있는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: Either report alone can be read in more than one way.
segments.tr: 어느 한 보고서만으로는 여러 가지 해석이 가능할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Read side by side, they help show whether the economy is cooling in an orderly way or whether inflation risks remain.
segments.tr: 두 보고서를 함께 보면 경제가 질서 있게 식어가고 있는지, 아니면 인플레이션 위험이 여전히 남아 있는지 파악하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the PCE Report
segments.tr: ## PCE 보고서에서 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: Policymakers have said they favor PCE over the better-known Consumer Price Index (CPI).
segments.tr: 정책 입안자들은 더 잘 알려진 소비자물가지수(CPI)보다 PCE를 선호한다고 밝혀왔습니다.

segments.src: PCE covers a broader range of spending and adjusts as consumers change what they buy when prices rise.
segments.tr: PCE는 더 광범위한 소비 지출을 포괄하며, 물가 상승 시 소비자가 구매 품목을 변경하는 것을 반영하여 조정됩니다.

segments.src: Key details to look for:
segments.tr: 주요 확인 사항:

segments.src: 1. **Headline vs. core.** Headline PCE includes food and energy. Core PCE leaves them out because they swing widely from month to month. Officials tend to focus on core as a guide to underlying trends.
segments.tr: 1. **헤드라인 vs. 근원.** 헤드라인 PCE에는 식품과 에너지가 포함됩니다. 근원 PCE는 월별 변동성이 큰 식품과 에너지를 제외합니다. 당국은 근원 지표를 기조적인 추세를 파악하는 지침으로 삼는 경향이 있습니다.

segments.src: 2. **Month-over-month change.** A small monthly reading can suggest progress. A rebound can raise concern about how sticky inflation is.
segments.tr: 2. **전월 대비 변화.** 월간 수치가 낮게 나오면 개선의 신호일 수 있습니다. 반등할 경우 인플레이션이 얼마나 끈질긴지에 대한 우려가 커질 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Services inflation.** Categories such as housing and healthcare have been slower to ease than goods prices. A steady decline here would be a meaningful sign.
segments.tr: 3. **서비스 인플레이션.** 주거비나 의료비와 같은 항목은 상품 가격보다 하락세가 더디게 나타나고 있습니다. 이 부문에서 꾸준한 하락세가 보인다면 의미 있는 신호가 될 것입니다.

segments.src: 4. **Personal income and spending.** These figures show whether households are still spending freely or pulling back.
segments.tr: 4. **개인 소득 및 지출.** 이 수치들은 가계가 여전히 자유롭게 소비하고 있는지, 아니면 지출을 줄이고 있는지 보여줍니다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the Jobs Report
segments.tr: ## 고용 보고서에서 주목해야 할 점

segments.src: The September employment report includes several numbers, and the headline job count is only one of them.
segments.tr: 9월 고용 보고서에는 여러 수치가 포함되어 있으며, 헤드라인 고용자 수는 그중 하나일 뿐입니다.

segments.src: - **Payroll growth.** Strong gains suggest continued demand for workers. A sharp slowdown could point to cooling momentum.
segments.tr: - **고용 증가.** 큰 폭의 증가는 노동 수요가 지속되고 있음을 시사합니다. 급격한 둔화는 모멘텀이 식고 있다는 신호일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Unemployment rate.** A small change in this rate can shift expectations about the economy.
segments.tr: - **실업률.** 이 수치의 작은 변화만으로도 경제에 대한 기대치가 바뀔 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Average hourly earnings.** Fast wage growth can add to inflation pressure, particularly in service industries.
segments.tr: - **평균 시간당 임금.** 빠른 임금 상승은 특히 서비스 산업에서 인플레이션 압력을 가중시킬 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Revisions.** Changes to prior months' figures can alter the picture as much as the new data.
segments.tr: - **수정치.** 이전 달 수치에 대한 수정은 새로운 데이터만큼이나 전체적인 상황을 바꿀 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## How the Data Could Be Read
segments.tr: ## 데이터 해석 방법

segments.src: Economists often describe a few broad outcomes.
segments.tr: 경제학자들은 종종 몇 가지 광범위한 결과를 설명합니다.

segments.src: None is certain.
segments.tr: 어느 것도 확실하지는 않습니다.

segments.src: | Scenario | Inflation | Jobs | Possible reading |
segments.tr: | 시나리오 | 인플레이션 | 고용 | 가능한 해석 |

segments.src: | Cooling | Softer than expected | Slower hiring | Case grows for holding rates steady |
segments.tr: | 둔화 | 예상보다 낮음 | 고용 둔화 | 금리 동결 명분 강화 |

segments.src: | Mixed | Softer | Stronger hiring | Fed may wait for more evidence |
segments.tr: | 혼조 | 낮음 | 고용 강세 | 연준, 추가 증거 대기 가능성 |

segments.src: | Mixed | Firmer | Slower hiring | Harder trade-off for policymakers |
segments.tr: | 혼조 | 높음 | 고용 둔화 | 정책 입안자들의 어려운 선택 |

segments.src: | Running hot | Firmer | Stronger hiring | Greater chance of further tightening |
segments.tr: | 과열 | 높음 | 고용 강세 | 추가 긴축 가능성 증대 |

segments.src: ## Why Markets React
segments.tr: ## 시장이 반응하는 이유

segments.src: Interest rate expectations affect many asset prices.
segments.tr: 금리 전망은 많은 자산 가격에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: Bond yields, the dollar, stock valuations and mortgage rates can all move on a single data release.
segments.tr: 채권 수익률, 달러 가치, 주식 밸류에이션, 주택 담보 대출 금리는 단 하나의 데이터 발표에도 움직일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Traders often adjust their views within minutes, and the early reaction can reverse as analysts look more closely at the details.
segments.tr: 트레이더들은 종종 몇 분 안에 자신의 견해를 수정하며, 분석가들이 세부 사항을 면밀히 검토함에 따라 초기 반응이 뒤집히기도 합니다.

segments.src: Some investors treat a single report with caution and prefer to look at trends over several months.
segments.tr: 일부 투자자들은 단일 보고서를 신중하게 대하며, 수개월에 걸친 추세를 보는 것을 선호합니다.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Everyday Households
segments.tr: ## 일반 가계에 미치는 의미

segments.src: Fed decisions can reach ordinary budgets in several ways:
segments.tr: 연준의 결정은 여러 경로를 통해 일반 가계 예산에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다:

segments.src: - **Borrowing costs.** Credit card rates, auto loans and home equity lines often follow the Fed's benchmark rate.
segments.tr: - **차입 비용.** 신용카드 금리, 자동차 대출, 주택 담보 대출은 종종 연준의 기준 금리를 따릅니다.

segments.src: - **Mortgages.** Rates are tied more closely to longer-term Treasury yields, but they respond to rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **주택 담보 대출.** 금리는 장기 국채 수익률과 더 밀접하게 연동되지만, 금리 전망에도 반응합니다.

segments.src: - **Savings.** Higher rates have generally meant better yields on savings accounts and certificates of deposit.
segments.tr: - **저축.** 금리 인상은 일반적으로 예금 계좌와 양도성 예금 증서(CD)의 수익률 상승을 의미합니다.

segments.src: - **Jobs and wages.** Tighter policy is meant to slow demand, which can affect hiring over time.
segments.tr: - **고용 및 임금.** 긴축 정책은 수요를 둔화시키기 위한 것이며, 이는 시간이 지남에 따라 고용에 영향을 줄 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 더 큰 그림

segments.src: The Fed has said its decisions depend on incoming data, so no single report is likely to settle the question.
segments.tr: 연준은 정책 결정이 들어오는 데이터에 달려 있다고 밝혔으므로, 단 하나의 보고서가 문제를 해결할 가능성은 낮습니다.

segments.src: Officials will also weigh other information, including CPI, business surveys, consumer spending and global conditions.
segments.tr: 당국은 CPI, 기업 설문조사, 소비자 지출, 글로벌 상황 등 다른 정보들도 함께 고려할 것입니다.

segments.src: Still, this week's releases fall at a time when investors are looking for signs of where policy is headed.
segments.tr: 그럼에도 이번 주 발표는 투자자들이 정책 방향에 대한 신호를 찾고 있는 시점에 이루어집니다.

segments.src: That is why they are drawing so much attention.
segments.tr: 그것이 바로 이 지표들이 그토록 많은 관심을 받는 이유입니다.

segments.src: ## Key Takeaways
segments.tr: ## 핵심 요약

segments.src: - PCE is the Fed's preferred inflation measure, and the core reading gets the most attention.
segments.tr: - PCE는 연준이 선호하는 인플레이션 지표이며, 근원 지표가 가장 큰 주목을 받습니다.

segments.src: - The jobs report shows how tight the labor market remains, with wages as a key detail.
segments.tr: - 고용 보고서는 노동 시장이 얼마나 타이트한지 보여주며, 임금은 핵심 세부 사항입니다.

segments.src: - Strong hiring paired with firm inflation would make further tightening more plausible.
segments.tr: - 고용 강세와 인플레이션 상승이 결합되면 추가 긴축 가능성이 높아집니다.

segments.src: - Softer readings on both would strengthen the case for a pause.
segments.tr: - 두 지표 모두 낮게 나온다면 금리 동결 명분이 강화될 것입니다.

segments.src: - Markets can be volatile around these releases, and first reactions do not always last.
segments.tr: - 시장은 이러한 발표 전후로 변동성이 커질 수 있으며, 초기 반응이 항상 지속되는 것은 아닙니다.

segments.src: *Economic data are subject to revision, and forecasts can be wrong.
segments.tr: *경제 데이터는 수정될 수 있으며, 전망은 틀릴 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Readers should consult official sources such as the Bureau of Economic Analysis and the Bureau of Labor Statistics for the latest figures, and a qualified professional for personal financial decisions.*
segments.tr: 독자들은 최신 수치를 확인하기 위해 경제분석국(BEA) 및 노동통계국(BLS)과 같은 공식 출처를 참고하고, 개인의 재무 결정에 대해서는 자격을 갖춘 전문가와 상담해야 합니다.*

zh.title: PCE与就业报告：可能决定美联储下一步行动的两份关键报告

segments.src: Two of the most closely watched economic releases of the year arrive within days of each other.
segments.tr: 今年最受关注的两份经济数据将在几天内相继发布。

segments.src: The Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, and the September jobs report will both be published this week.
segments.tr: 个人消费支出（PCE）物价指数（美联储首选的通胀指标）和9月就业报告都将在本周公布。

segments.src: Together they give investors, businesses and households their clearest look yet at whether the central bank is likely to keep raising interest rates into the new year or to hold steady.
segments.tr: 这两份报告将共同为投资者、企业和家庭提供最清晰的视角，让他们了解央行是否会在新的一年里继续加息，还是会保持利率稳定。

segments.src: *This article is for general information only.
segments.tr: *本文仅供一般信息参考。

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or financial advice.*
segments.tr: 它不构成投资、税务或财务建议.*

segments.src: ## Why These Two Reports Matter Together
segments.tr: ## 为什么这两份报告同等重要

segments.src: The Fed has a dual mandate: stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: 美联储拥有双重使命：物价稳定和最大就业。

segments.src: Each report speaks to one half of it.
segments.tr: 每份报告都对应其中一个方面。

segments.src: - **PCE inflation** shows whether price pressures are cooling toward the Fed's 2% target.
segments.tr: - **PCE通胀率**显示价格压力是否在向美联储2%的目标回落。

segments.src: - **Nonfarm payrolls** show whether the labor market is still running hot enough to keep wages and spending elevated.
segments.tr: - **非农就业人数**显示劳动力市场是否仍然足够火热，以维持工资和支出的高位。

segments.src: Either report alone can be read in more than one way.
segments.tr: 单独来看，任何一份报告都可能有多种解读方式。

segments.src: Read side by side, they help show whether the economy is cooling in an orderly way or whether inflation risks remain.
segments.tr: 但如果结合起来看，它们有助于表明经济是在有序放温，还是通胀风险依然存在。

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the PCE Report
segments.tr: ## PCE报告中需要关注什么

segments.src: Policymakers have said they favor PCE over the better-known Consumer Price Index (CPI).
segments.tr: 决策者曾表示，他们更青睐PCE，而不是更广为人知的消费者价格指数（CPI）。

segments.src: PCE covers a broader range of spending and adjusts as consumers change what they buy when prices rise.
segments.tr: PCE涵盖范围更广的消费，并且会随着消费者在价格上涨时改变购买偏好而进行调整。

segments.src: Key details to look for:
segments.tr: 需要寻找的关键细节：

segments.src: 1. **Headline vs. core.** Headline PCE includes food and energy. Core PCE leaves them out because they swing widely from month to month. Officials tend to focus on core as a guide to underlying trends.
segments.tr: 1. **整体与核心通胀。** 整体PCE包括食品和能源。核心PCE则排除了这两项，因为它们的月度波动较大。官员们倾向于将核心数据作为指导潜在趋势的指标。

segments.src: 2. **Month-over-month change.** A small monthly reading can suggest progress. A rebound can raise concern about how sticky inflation is.
segments.tr: 2. **环比变化。** 较低的月度数据可能暗示进展。反弹则可能引发对通胀粘性的担忧。

segments.src: 3. **Services inflation.** Categories such as housing and healthcare have been slower to ease than goods prices. A steady decline here would be a meaningful sign.
segments.tr: 3. **服务通胀。** 住房和医疗保健等类别的缓解速度一直慢于商品价格。如果这些领域出现稳步下降，将是一个有意义的信号。

segments.src: 4. **Personal income and spending.** These figures show whether households are still spending freely or pulling back.
segments.tr: 4. **个人收入与支出。** 这些数据表明家庭是在继续自由消费还是在收紧荷包。

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the Jobs Report
segments.tr: ## 就业报告中需要关注什么

segments.src: The September employment report includes several numbers, and the headline job count is only one of them.
segments.tr: 9月就业报告包含多项数据，而整体新增就业岗位只是其中之一。

segments.src: - **Payroll growth.** Strong gains suggest continued demand for workers. A sharp slowdown could point to cooling momentum.
segments.tr: - **就业增长。** 强劲的增长表明对工人的持续需求。急剧放缓可能指向动能减弱。

segments.src: - **Unemployment rate.** A small change in this rate can shift expectations about the economy.
segments.tr: - **失业率。** 该比率的微小变化可能会改变对经济的预期。

segments.src: - **Average hourly earnings.** Fast wage growth can add to inflation pressure, particularly in service industries.
segments.tr: - **平均时薪。** 快速的工资增长可能会加剧通胀压力，特别是在服务行业。

segments.src: - **Revisions.** Changes to prior months' figures can alter the picture as much as the new data.
segments.tr: - **修正值。** 对前几个月数据的修改可能会像新数据一样改变整体图景。

segments.src: ## How the Data Could Be Read
segments.tr: ## 这些数据可能如何被解读

segments.src: Economists often describe a few broad outcomes.
segments.tr: 经济学家经常描述几种大致的结果。

segments.src: None is certain.
segments.tr: 没有一种是确定的。

segments.src: | Scenario | Inflation | Jobs | Possible reading |
segments.tr: | Scenario | Inflation | Jobs | Possible reading |

segments.src: | Cooling | Softer than expected | Slower hiring | Case grows for holding rates steady |
segments.tr: | 冷却 | 低于预期 | 招聘放缓 | 维持利率不变的理由增加 |

segments.src: | Mixed | Softer | Stronger hiring | Fed may wait for more evidence |

segments.src: ## Why Markets React

segments.src: Interest rate expectations affect many asset prices.

segments.src: Traders often adjust their views within minutes, and the early reaction can reverse as analysts look more closely at the details.

segments.src: Some investors treat a single report with caution and prefer to look at trends over several months.
segments.tr: 一些投资者对单一报告持谨慎态度，更愿意观察几个月来的趋势。

segments.src: ## What It Means for Everyday Households
segments.tr: ## 这对普通家庭意味着什么

segments.src: Fed decisions can reach ordinary budgets in several ways:
segments.tr: 美联储的决策可以通过多种方式影响普通人的预算：

segments.src: - **Borrowing costs.** Credit card rates, auto loans and home equity lines often follow the Fed's benchmark rate.
segments.tr: - **借贷成本。** 信用卡利率、汽车贷款和房屋净值信贷额度通常跟随美联储的基准利率。

segments.src: - **Mortgages.** Rates are tied more closely to longer-term Treasury yields, but they respond to rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **抵押贷款。** 利率与长期国债收益率的联系更紧密，但它们对利率预期做出反应。

segments.src: - **Savings.** Higher rates have generally meant better yields on savings accounts and certificates of deposit.
segments.tr: - **储蓄。** 更高的利率通常意味着储蓄账户和存单有更好的收益率。

segments.src: - **Jobs and wages.** Tighter policy is meant to slow demand, which can affect hiring over time.
segments.tr: - **就业与工资。** 更紧缩的政策旨在放缓需求，这可能会随着时间的推移影响招聘。

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## 更宏大的图景

segments.src: The Fed has said its decisions depend on incoming data, so no single report is likely to settle the question.
segments.tr: 美联储曾表示其决策取决于即将来临的数据，因此任何单一报告都不太可能一锤定音。

segments.src: Officials will also weigh other information, including CPI, business surveys, consumer spending and global conditions.

segments.src: Still, this week's releases fall at a time when investors are looking for signs of where policy is headed.

segments.src: That is why they are drawing so much attention.

segments.src: ## Why These Two Reports Matter Together
segments.tr: ## Why These Two Reports Matter Together

segments.src: The Fed has a dual mandate: stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: फेड का एक दोहरा अधिदेश है: स्थिर कीमतें और अधिकतम रोजगार।

segments.src: Each report speaks to one half of it.
segments.tr: प्रत्येक रिपोर्ट इसके एक हिस्से के बारे में बताती है।

segments.src: - **PCE inflation** shows whether price pressures are cooling toward the Fed's 2% target.
segments.tr: - **PCE inflation** दिखाता है कि क्या मूल्य दबाव फेड के 2% लक्ष्य की ओर ठंडा हो रहा है।

segments.src: - **Nonfarm payrolls** show whether the labor market is still running hot enough to keep wages and spending elevated.
segments.tr: - **Nonfarm payrolls** दिखाते हैं कि क्या श्रम बाजार अभी भी वेतन और खर्च को ऊंचा रखने के लिए पर्याप्त रूप से गर्म चल रहा है।

segments.src: Either report alone can be read in more than one way.
segments.tr: किसी भी एक रिपोर्ट को एक से अधिक तरीकों से पढ़ा जा सकता है।

segments.src: Read side by side, they help show whether the economy is cooling in an orderly way or whether inflation risks remain.
segments.tr: साथ-साथ पढ़ने पर, वे यह दिखाने में मदद करते हैं कि क्या अर्थव्यवस्था व्यवस्थित तरीके से ठंडी हो रही है या क्या मुद्रास्फीति का जोखिम बना हुआ है।

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the PCE Report
segments.tr: ## What to Watch in the PCE Report

segments.src: Policymakers have said they favor PCE over the better-known Consumer Price Index (CPI).
segments.tr: नीति निर्माताओं ने कहा है कि वे अधिक प्रसिद्ध उपभोक्ता मूल्य सूचकांक (CPI) की तुलना में PCE को प्राथमिकता देते हैं।

segments.src: PCE covers a broader range of spending and adjusts as consumers change what they buy when prices rise.
segments.tr: PCE खर्च की एक व्यापक श्रृंखला को कवर करता है और कीमतें बढ़ने पर उपभोक्ता जो खरीदते हैं उसमें बदलाव के अनुसार समायोजित होता है।

segments.src: Key details to look for:
segments.tr: खोजने के लिए मुख्य विवरण:

segments.src: 1. **Headline vs. core.** Headline PCE includes food and energy. Core PCE leaves them out because they swing widely from month to month. Officials tend to focus on core as a guide to underlying trends.
segments.tr: 1. **Headline vs. core.** Headline PCE में भोजन और ऊर्जा शामिल हैं। Core PCE उन्हें बाहर रखता है क्योंकि वे महीने-दर-महीने काफी उतार-चढ़ाव करते हैं। अधिकारी अंतर्निहित रुझानों के मार्गदर्शन के रूप में कोर पर ध्यान केंद्रित करते हैं।

segments.src: 2. **Month-over-month change.** A small monthly reading can suggest progress. A rebound can raise concern about how sticky inflation is.
segments.tr: 2. **Month-over-month change.** एक छोटी मासिक रीडिंग प्रगति का सुझाव दे सकती है। रिबाउंड इस बात पर चिंता बढ़ा सकता है कि मुद्रास्फीति कितनी चिपचिपी है।

segments.src: 3. **Services inflation.** Categories such as housing and healthcare have been slower to ease than goods prices. A steady decline here would be a meaningful sign.
segments.tr: 3. **Services inflation.** आवास और स्वास्थ्य सेवा जैसी श्रेणियां वस्तुओं की कीमतों की तुलना में धीमी गति से आसान हुई हैं। यहां एक स्थिर गिरावट एक सार्थक संकेत होगी।

segments.src: 4. **Personal income and spending.** These figures show whether households are still spending freely or pulling back.
segments.tr: 4. **Personal income and spending.** ये आंकड़े बताते हैं कि क्या परिवार अभी भी स्वतंत्र रूप से खर्च कर रहे हैं या पीछे हट रहे हैं।

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the Jobs Report
segments.tr: ## What to Watch in the Jobs Report

segments.src: The September employment report includes several numbers, and the headline job count is only one of them.
segments.tr: सितंबर की रोजगार रिपोर्ट में कई संख्याएँ शामिल हैं, और हेडलाइन जॉब काउंट उनमें से केवल एक है।

segments.src: - **Payroll growth.** Strong gains suggest continued demand for workers. A sharp slowdown could point to cooling momentum.
segments.tr: - **Payroll growth.** मजबूत लाभ श्रमिकों की निरंतर मांग का सुझाव देते हैं। एक तेज मंदी ठंडा होने वाली गति की ओर इशारा कर सकती है।

segments.src: - **Unemployment rate.** A small change in this rate can shift expectations about the economy.
segments.tr: - **Unemployment rate.** इस दर में एक छोटा सा बदलाव अर्थव्यवस्था के बारे में उम्मीदों को बदल सकता है।

segments.src: - **Average hourly earnings.** Fast wage growth can add to inflation pressure, particularly in service industries.
segments.tr: - **Average hourly earnings.** तेजी से मजदूरी वृद्धि मुद्रास्फीति के दबाव को बढ़ा सकती है, विशेष रूप से सेवा उद्योगों में।

segments.src: - **Revisions.** Changes to prior months' figures can alter the picture as much as the new data.
segments.tr: - **Revisions.** पिछले महीनों के आंकड़ों में बदलाव नए डेटा की तरह ही तस्वीर को बदल सकता है।

es.title: PCE y nóminas: Los dos informes que podrían determinar el próximo movimiento de la Fed

segments.src: Two of the most closely watched economic releases of the year arrive within days of each other.
segments.tr: Dos de los informes económicos más seguidos del año llegan con pocos días de diferencia.

segments.src: The Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, and the September jobs report will both be published this week.
segments.tr: El índice de precios de los Gastos de Consumo Personal (PCE, por sus siglas en inglés), el indicador de inflación preferido de la Reserva Federal, y el informe de empleo de septiembre se publicarán esta semana.

segments.src: - **Nonfarm payrolls** show whether the labor market is still running hot enough to keep wages and spending elevated.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the PCE Report
segments.tr: ## Qué observar en el informe PCE

segments.src: Policymakers have said they favor PCE over the better-known Consumer Price Index (CPI).
segments.tr: Los responsables de la política monetaria han dicho que prefieren el PCE sobre el más conocido Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC).

segments.src: PCE covers a broader range of spending and adjusts as consumers change what they buy when prices rise.
segments.tr: El PCE cubre una gama más amplia de gastos y se ajusta a medida que los consumidores cambian lo que compran cuando los precios suben.

segments.src: Key details to look for:
segments.tr: Detalles clave a tener en cuenta:

segments.src: 1. **Headline vs. core.** Headline PCE includes food and energy. Core PCE leaves them out because they swing widely from month to month. Officials tend to focus on core as a guide to underlying trends.
segments.tr: 1. **General vs. subyacente.** El PCE general incluye alimentos y energía. El PCE subyacente los excluye porque fluctúan mucho de un mes a otro. Los funcionarios tienden a centrarse en el subyacente como guía de las tendencias subyacentes.

segments.src: 2. **Month-over-month change.** A small monthly reading can suggest progress. A rebound can raise concern about how sticky inflation is.
segments.tr: 2. **Cambio mensual.** Una lectura mensual pequeña puede sugerir progreso. Un repunte puede generar preocupación sobre cuán persistente es la inflación.

segments.src: 3. **Services inflation.** Categories such as housing and healthcare have been slower to ease than goods prices. A steady decline here would be a meaningful sign.
segments.tr: 3. **Inflación de servicios.** Categorías como la vivienda y la atención médica han tardado más en moderarse que los precios de los bienes. Un descenso constante aquí sería una señal significativa.

segments.src: 4. **Personal income and spending.** These figures show whether households are still spending freely or pulling back.
segments.tr: 4. **Ingresos y gastos personales.** Estas cifras muestran si los hogares siguen gastando libremente o si están recortando gastos.

fr.title: PCE et emploi : les deux rapports qui pourraient orienter la prochaine décision de la Fed

segments.src: Two of the most closely watched economic releases of the year arrive within days of each other.
segments.tr: Deux des publications économiques les plus suivies de l'année arrivent à quelques jours d'intervalle.

segments.src: The Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, and the September jobs report will both be published this week.
segments.tr: L'indice des prix des dépenses de consommation personnelle (PCE), la mesure de l'inflation privilégiée par la Réserve fédérale, et le rapport sur l'emploi de septembre seront tous deux publiés cette semaine.

segments.src: Together they give investors, businesses and households their clearest look yet at whether the central bank is likely to keep raising interest rates into the new year or to hold steady.
segments.tr: Ensemble, ils offrent aux investisseurs, aux entreprises et aux ménages une vision très claire sur la possibilité que la banque centrale continue d'augmenter ses taux d'intérêt au cours de la nouvelle année ou qu'elle les maintienne inchangés.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only.
segments.tr: *Cet article est fourni à titre d'information générale uniquement.

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or financial advice.*
segments.tr: Il ne constitue pas un conseil en investissement, fiscal ou financier.*

segments.src: ## Why These Two Reports Matter Together
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi ces deux rapports sont importants ensemble

segments.src: The Fed has a dual mandate: stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: La Fed a un double mandat : la stabilité des prix et le plein emploi.

segments.src: Each report speaks to one half of it.
segments.tr: Chaque rapport répond à l'une de ces deux missions.

segments.src: - **PCE inflation** shows whether price pressures are cooling toward the Fed's 2% target.
segments.tr: - **L'inflation PCE** montre si les pressions sur les prix ralentissent pour se rapprocher de l'objectif de 2 % de la Fed.

segments.src: - **Nonfarm payrolls** show whether the labor market is still running hot enough to keep wages and spending elevated.
segments.tr: - **Les créations d'emplois non agricoles** montrent si le marché du travail reste suffisamment dynamique pour maintenir les salaires et les dépenses à un niveau élevé.

segments.src: Either report alone can be read in more than one way.
segments.tr: Chaque rapport pris isolément peut être interprété de différentes manières.

segments.src: Read side by side, they help show whether the economy is cooling in an orderly way or whether inflation risks remain.
segments.tr: Lus côte à côte, ils permettent de savoir si l'économie se refroidit de manière ordonnée ou si des risques d'inflation subsistent.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the PCE Report
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller dans le rapport PCE

segments.src: Policymakers have said they favor PCE over the better-known Consumer Price Index (CPI).
segments.tr: Les responsables politiques ont déclaré préférer le PCE à l'indice des prix à la consommation (CPI), plus connu.

segments.src: PCE covers a broader range of spending and adjusts as consumers change what they buy when prices rise.
segments.tr: Le PCE couvre une gamme plus large de dépenses et s'ajuste lorsque les consommateurs modifient leurs achats en réponse à la hausse des prix.

segments.src: Key details to look for:
segments.tr: Principaux détails à examiner :

segments.src: 1. **Headline vs. core.** Headline PCE includes food and energy. Core PCE leaves them out because they swing widely from month to month. Officials tend to focus on core as a guide to underlying trends.
segments.tr: 1. **Indice global vs indice sous-jacent (core).** Le PCE global inclut l'alimentation et l'énergie. Le PCE sous-jacent les exclut en raison de leur forte volatilité mensuelle. Les responsables ont tendance à se concentrer sur le sous-jacent pour évaluer les tendances de fond.

segments.src: 2. **Month-over-month change.** A small monthly reading can suggest progress. A rebound can raise concern about how sticky inflation is.
segments.tr: 2. **Variation d'un mois sur l'autre.** Une faible lecture mensuelle peut suggérer des progrès. Un rebond peut susciter des inquiétudes quant à la persistance de l'inflation.

segments.src: 3. **Services inflation.** Categories such as housing and healthcare have been slower to ease than goods prices. A steady decline here would be a meaningful sign.
segments.tr: 3. **L'inflation des services.** Des catégories telles que le logement et les soins de santé ont été plus lentes à se détendre que les prix des biens. Une baisse continue dans ce secteur constituerait un signal significatif.

segments.src: 4. **Personal income and spending.** These figures show whether households are still spending freely or pulling back.
segments.tr: 4. **Les revenus et dépenses des ménages.** Ces chiffres indiquent si les ménages continuent de dépenser librement ou s'ils réduisent leurs dépenses.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the Jobs Report
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il faut surveiller dans le rapport sur l'emploi

segments.src: The September employment report includes several numbers, and the headline job count is only one of them.
segments.tr: Le rapport sur l'emploi de septembre comprend plusieurs chiffres, et le nombre total de créations d'emplois n'en est qu'un parmi d'autres.

segments.src: - **Payroll growth.** Strong gains suggest continued demand for workers. A sharp slowdown could point to cooling momentum.
segments.tr: - **Croissance de l'emploi.** De fortes gains suggèrent une demande continue de travailleurs. Un ralentissement marqué pourrait indiquer une perte de vitesse.

segments.src: - **Unemployment rate.** A small change in this rate can shift expectations about the economy.
segments.tr: - **Taux de chômage.** Une variation minime de ce taux peut modifier les attentes concernant l'économie.

segments.src: - **Average hourly earnings.** Fast wage growth can add to inflation pressure, particularly in service industries.
segments.tr: - **Gains horaires moyens.** Une croissance rapide des salaires peut renforcer les pressions inflations, en particulier dans les industries de services.

segments.src: - **Revisions.** Changes to prior months' figures can alter the picture as much as the new data.
segments.tr: - **Révisions.** Les ajustements apportés aux chiffres des mois précédents peuvent modifier la situation tout autant que les nouvelles données.

segments.src: ## How the Data Could Be Read
segments.tr: ## Comment les données pourraient être interprétées

segments.src: Economists often describe a few broad outcomes.
segments.tr: Les économistes décrivent souvent quelques grands scénarios.

segments.src: None is certain.
segments.tr: Aucun n'est certain.

segments.src: | Scenario | Inflation | Jobs | Possible reading |
segments.tr: | Scénario | Inflation | Emplois | Interprétation possible |

segments.src: | Cooling | Softer than expected | Slower hiring | Case grows for holding rates steady |
segments.tr: | Refroidissement | Plus faible que prévu | Embauches plus lentes | Renforce l'argument d'un maintien des taux inchangés |

segments.src: | Mixed | Softer | Stronger hiring | Fed may wait for more evidence |
segments.tr: | Mitigé | Plus faible | Embauches plus solides | La Fed pourrait attendre d'autres preuves |

segments.src: | Mixed | Firmer | Slower hiring | Harder trade-off for policymakers |
segments.tr: | Mitigé | Plus ferme | Embauches plus lentes | Arbitrage plus difficile pour les décideurs |

segments.src: | Running hot | Firmer | Stronger hiring | Greater chance of further tightening |
segments.tr: | Surchauffe | Plus ferme | Embauches plus solides | Plus forte probabilité d'un resserrement supplémentaire |

segments.src: ## Why Markets React
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les marchés réagissent

segments.src: Interest rate expectations affect many asset prices.
segments.tr: Les anticipations de taux d'intérêt affectent de nombreux prix d'actifs.

segments.src: Bond yields, the dollar, stock valuations and mortgage rates can all move on a single data release.
segments.tr: Les rendements obligataires, le dollar, les valorisations boursières et les taux hypothécaires peuvent tous évoluer lors d'une seule publication de données.

segments.src: Traders often adjust their views within minutes, and the early reaction can reverse as analysts look more closely at the details.
segments.tr: Les traders ajustent souvent leurs perspectives en quelques minutes, et la réaction initiale peut s'inverser au fur et à mesure que les analystes examinent les détails de plus près.

segments.src: Some investors treat a single report with caution and prefer to look at trends over several months.
segments.tr: Certains investisseurs abordent un rapport unique avec prudence et préfèrent observer les tendances sur plusieurs mois.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Everyday Households
segments.tr: ## Ce que cela signifie pour les ménages au quotidien

segments.src: Fed decisions can reach ordinary budgets in several ways:
segments.tr: Les décisions de la Fed peuvent impacter les budgets ordinaires de plusieurs manières :

segments.src: - **Borrowing costs.** Credit card rates, auto loans and home equity lines often follow the Fed's benchmark rate.
segments.tr: - **Coûts d'emprunt.** Les taux des cartes de crédit, des prêts automobiles et des marges de crédit hypothécaire suivent souvent le taux directeur de la Fed.

segments.src: - **Mortgages.** Rates are tied more closely to longer-term Treasury yields, but they respond to rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **Crédits immobiliers.** Les taux sont plus étroitement liés aux rendements des obligations du Trésor à plus long terme, mais ils réagissent aux attentes concernant les taux.

segments.src: - **Savings.** Higher rates have generally meant better yields on savings accounts and certificates of deposit.
segments.tr: - **Épargne.** Des taux plus élevés signifient généralement de meilleurs rendements sur les comptes d'épargne et les certificats de dépôt.

segments.src: - **Jobs and wages.** Tighter policy is meant to slow demand, which can affect hiring over time.
segments.tr: - **Emplois et salaires.** Une politique plus stricte vise à ralentir la demande, ce qui peut affecter le recrutement au fil du temps.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Une vue d'ensemble

segments.src: The Fed has said its decisions depend on incoming data, so no single report is likely to settle the question.
segments.tr: La Fed a déclaré que ses décisions dépendent des données à venir, de sorte qu'aucun rapport isolé ne tranchera probablement la question.

segments.src: Officials will also weigh other information, including CPI, business surveys, consumer spending and global conditions.
segments.tr: Les responsables évalueront également d'autres informations, notamment le CPI, les enquêtes auprès des entreprises, la consommation des ménages et la conjoncture mondiale.

segments.src: Still, this week's releases fall at a time when investors are looking for signs of where policy is headed.
segments.tr: Néanmoins, les publications de cette semaine surviennent à un moment où les investisseurs cherchent des indices sur la trajectoire de la politique monétaire.

segments.src: That is why they are drawing so much attention.
segments.tr: C'est pourquoi elles attirent autant l'attention.

segments.src: ## Key Takeaways
segments.tr: ## Points clés à retenir

segments.src: - PCE is the Fed's preferred inflation measure, and the core reading gets the most attention.
segments.tr: - Le PCE est la mesure d'inflation préférée de la Fed, et la donnée sous-jacente retient la plus grande attention.

segments.src: - The jobs report shows how tight the labor market remains, with wages as a key detail.
segments.tr: - Le rapport sur l'emploi montre à quel point le marché du travail reste tendu, les salaires constituant un détail clé.

segments.src: - Strong hiring paired with firm inflation would make further tightening more plausible.
segments.tr: - Des embauches solides combinées à une inflation ferme rendraient un resserrement supplémentaire plus plausible.

segments.src: - Softer readings on both would strengthen the case for a pause.
segments.tr: - Des données plus faibles sur ces deux fronts renforceraient l'argument en faveur d'une pause.

segments.src: - Markets can be volatile around these releases, and first reactions do not always last.
segments.tr: - Les marchés peuvent être volatils autour de ces publications, et les premières réactions ne durent pas toujours.

segments.src: *Economic data are subject to revision, and forecasts can be wrong.
segments.tr: *Les données économiques sont sujettes à révision et les prévisions peuvent être erronées.

in.title: PCE dan Payrolls: Dua Laporan yang Dapat Membentuk Langkah Fed Selanjutnya

segments.src: Two of the most closely watched economic releases of the year arrive within days of each other.
segments.tr: Dua rilis ekonomi yang paling cermat dipantau tahun ini hadir hanya berselang beberapa hari.

segments.src: The Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, and the September jobs report will both be published this week.
segments.tr: Indeks harga Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE), ukuran inflasi yang lebih disukai Federal Reserve, dan laporan lapangan kerja bulan September akan sama-sama dipublikasikan minggu ini.

segments.src: Together they give investors, businesses and households their clearest look yet at whether the central bank is likely to keep raising interest rates into the new year or to hold steady.
segments.tr: Bersama-sama, keduanya memberikan gambaran paling jelas bagi investor, bisnis, dan rumah tangga mengenai apakah bank sentral kemungkinan akan terus menaikkan suku bunga hingga tahun baru atau mempertahankannya.

segments.src: *This article is for general information only.
segments.tr: *Artikel ini hanya untuk informasi umum.

segments.src: It is not investment, tax or financial advice.*
segments.tr: Ini bukan nasihat investasi, pajak, atau keuangan.*

segments.src: ## Why These Two Reports Matter Together
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Kedua Laporan Ini Penting Jika Dilihat Bersama

segments.src: The Fed has a dual mandate: stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: Fed memiliki mandat ganda: harga yang stabil dan lapangan kerja maksimum.

segments.src: Each report speaks to one half of it.
segments.tr: Masing-masing laporan berbicara tentang salah satu dari mandat tersebut.

segments.src: - **PCE inflation** shows whether price pressures are cooling toward the Fed's 2% target.
segments.tr: - **Inflasi PCE** menunjukkan apakah tekanan harga mereda menuju target 2% dari Fed.

segments.src: - **Nonfarm payrolls** show whether the labor market is still running hot enough to keep wages and spending elevated.
segments.tr: - **Nonfarm payrolls** menunjukkan apakah pasar tenaga kerja masih cukup panas hingga membuat upah dan pengeluaran tetap tinggi.

segments.src: Either report alone can be read in more than one way.
segments.tr: Masing-masing laporan secara terpisah dapat dibaca dengan lebih dari satu cara.

segments.src: Read side by side, they help show whether the economy is cooling in an orderly way or whether inflation risks remain.
segments.tr: Dibaca secara berdampingan, laporan tersebut membantu menunjukkan apakah ekonomi mereda secara teratur atau apakah risiko inflasi masih bertahan.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the PCE Report
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Perlu Diperhatikan dalam Laporan PCE

segments.src: Policymakers have said they favor PCE over the better-known Consumer Price Index (CPI).
segments.tr: Para pembuat kebijakan telah menyatakan bahwa mereka lebih menyukai PCE daripada Consumer Price Index (CPI) yang lebih dikenal.

segments.src: PCE covers a broader range of spending and adjusts as consumers change what they buy when prices rise.
segments.tr: PCE mencakup rentang pengeluaran yang lebih luas dan menyesuaikan saat konsumen mengubah apa yang mereka beli ketika harga naik.

segments.src: Key details to look for:
segments.tr: Rincian utama yang perlu dicari:

segments.src: 1. **Headline vs. core.** Headline PCE includes food and energy. Core PCE leaves them out because they swing widely from month to month. Officials tend to focus on core as a guide to underlying trends.
segments.tr: 1. **Headline vs. core.** PCE headline mencakup makanan dan energi. PCE core mengesampingkannya karena nilainya berfluktuasi tajam dari bulan ke bulan. Pejabat cenderung berfokus pada core sebagai panduan untuk tren yang mendasarinya.

segments.src: 2. **Month-over-month change.** A small monthly reading can suggest progress. A rebound can raise concern about how sticky inflation is.
segments.tr: 2. **Perubahan dari bulan ke bulan.** Angka bulanan yang kecil dapat mengindikasikan adanya kemajuan. Pemulihan naik (rebound) dapat menimbulkan kekhawatiran tentang seberapa persistennya inflasi.

segments.src: 3. **Services inflation.** Categories such as housing and healthcare have been slower to ease than goods prices. A steady decline here would be a meaningful sign.
segments.tr: 3. **Inflasi jasa.** Kategori seperti perumahan dan layanan kesehatan lebih lambat mereda dibandingkan harga barang. Penurunan yang stabil di sini akan menjadi tanda yang signifikan.

segments.src: 4. **Personal income and spending.** These figures show whether households are still spending freely or pulling back.
segments.tr: 4. **Pendapatan dan pengeluaran pribadi.** Angka-angka ini menunjukkan apakah rumah tangga masih berbelanja secara bebas atau mulai menahan diri.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the Jobs Report
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Perlu Diperhatikan dalam Laporan Lapangan Kerja

segments.src: The September employment report includes several numbers, and the headline job count is only one of them.
segments.tr: Laporan ketenagakerjaan bulan September mencakup beberapa angka, dan jumlah pekerjaan utama hanyalah salah satunya.

segments.src: - **Payroll growth.** Strong gains suggest continued demand for workers. A sharp slowdown could point to cooling momentum.
segments.tr: - **Pertumbuhan payroll.** Pertumbuhan yang kuat menunjukkan permintaan tenaga kerja yang terus berlanjut. Perlambatan tajam dapat mengindikasikan momentum yang mereda.

segments.src: - **Unemployment rate.** A small change in this rate can shift expectations about the economy.
segments.tr: - **Tingkat pengangguran.** Perubahan kecil pada tingkat ini dapat menggeser ekspektasi terhadap perekonomian.

segments.src: - **Average hourly earnings.** Fast wage growth can add to inflation pressure, particularly in service industries.
segments.tr: - **Rata-rata penghasilan per jam.** Pertumbuhan upah yang cepat dapat menambah tekanan inflasi, khususnya di industri jasa.

segments.src: - **Revisions.** Changes to prior months' figures can alter the picture as much as the new data.
segments.tr: - **Revisi.** Perubahan pada angka bulan-bulan sebelumnya dapat mengubah gambaran sebesar data baru.

segments.src: ## How the Data Could Be Read
segments.tr: ## Bagaimana Data Dapat Dibaca

segments.src: Economists often describe a few broad outcomes.
segments.tr: Para ekonom sering kali menggambarkan beberapa hasil secara garis besar.

segments.src: None is certain.
segments.tr: Tidak ada yang pasti.

segments.src: | Scenario | Inflation | Jobs | Possible reading |
segments.tr: | Skenario | Inflasi | Lapangan Kerja | Kemungkinan interpretasi |

segments.src: | Cooling | Softer than expected | Slower hiring | Case grows for holding rates steady |
segments.tr: | Mereda | Lebih rendah dari perkiraan | Perekrutan lebih lambat | Alasan untuk menahan suku bunga tetap stabil semakin kuat |

segments.src: | Mixed | Softer | Stronger hiring | Fed may wait for more evidence |
segments.tr: | Campuran | Lebih rendah | Perekrutan lebih kuat | Fed mungkin menunggu bukti lebih lanjut |

segments.src: | Mixed | Firmer | Slower hiring | Harder trade-off for policymakers |
segments.tr: | Campuran | Lebih tinggi | Perekrutan lebih lambat | Kompromi yang lebih sulit bagi pembuat kebijakan |

segments.src: | Running hot | Firmer | Stronger hiring | Greater chance of further tightening |
segments.tr: | Tetap panas | Lebih tinggi | Perekrutan lebih kuat | Peluang lebih besar untuk pengetatan lebih lanjut |

segments.src: ## Why Markets React
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Pasar Bereaksi

segments.src: Interest rate expectations affect many asset prices.
segments.tr: Ekspektasi suku bunga memengaruhi banyak harga aset.

segments.src: Bond yields, the dollar, stock valuations and mortgage rates can all move on a single data release.
segments.tr: Imbal hasil obligasi, dolar, valurasi saham, dan suku bunga KPR semuanya dapat bergerak berdasarkan satu rilis data.

segments.src: Traders often adjust their views within minutes, and the early reaction can reverse as analysts look more closely at the details.
segments.tr: Trader sering kali menyesuaikan pandangan mereka dalam hitungan menit, dan reaksi awal dapat berbalik arah saat para analis meneliti rinciannya secara lebih cermat.

segments.src: Some investors treat a single report with caution and prefer to look at trends over several months.
segments.tr: Beberapa investor menyikapi satu laporan dengan berhati-hati dan lebih memilih untuk melihat tren selama beberapa bulan.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Everyday Households
segments.tr: ## Apa Artinya bagi Rumah Tangga Sehari-hari

segments.src: Fed decisions can reach ordinary budgets in several ways:
segments.tr: Keputusan Fed dapat berdampak pada anggaran harian melalui beberapa cara:

segments.src: - **Borrowing costs.** Credit card rates, auto loans and home equity lines often follow the Fed's benchmark rate.
segments.tr: - **Biaya pinjaman.** Suku bunga kartu kredit, pinjaman auto, dan fasilitas kredit rumah sering kali mengikuti suku bunga acuan Fed.

segments.src: - **Mortgages.** Rates are tied more closely to longer-term Treasury yields, but they respond to rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **KPR.** Suku bunga KPR terikat lebih erat dengan imbal hasil obligasi AS jangka panjang, tetapi tetap merespons ekspektasi suku bunga.

segments.src: - **Savings.** Higher rates have generally meant better yields on savings accounts and certificates of deposit.
segments.tr: - **Tabungan.** Suku bunga yang lebih tinggi umumnya memberikan imbal hasil yang lebih baik pada rekening tabungan dan deposito berjangka.

segments.src: - **Jobs and wages.** Tighter policy is meant to slow demand, which can affect hiring over time.
segments.tr: - **Pekerjaan dan upah.** Kebijakan yang lebih ketat dimaksudkan untuk memperlambat permintaan, yang seiring waktu dapat memengaruhi perekrutan.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Gambaran yang Lebih Luas

segments.src: The Fed has said its decisions depend on incoming data, so no single report is likely to settle the question.
segments.tr: Fed menyatakan bahwa keputusannya bergantung pada data yang masuk, sehingga tidak ada satu laporan pun yang kemungkinan besar dapat menyelesaikan pertanyaan tersebut.

segments.src: Officials will also weigh other information, including CPI, business surveys, consumer spending and global conditions.
segments.tr: Para pejabat juga akan menimbang informasi lain, termasuk CPI, survei bisnis, pengeluaran konsumen, dan kondisi global.

segments.src: Still, this week's releases fall at a time when investors are looking for signs of where policy is headed.
segments.tr: Meskipun demikian, rilis minggu ini hadir pada saat para investor mencari tanda-tanda ke mana arah kebijakan selanjutnya.

segments.src: That is why they are drawing so much attention.
segments.tr: Itulah mengapa laporan-laporan ini menarik begitu banyak perhatian.

segments.src: ## Key Takeaways
segments.tr: ## Poin-Poin Kunci

segments.src: - PCE is the Fed's preferred inflation measure, and the core reading gets the most attention.
segments.tr: - PCE adalah ukuran inflasi yang lebih disukai Fed, dan angka core mendapatkan perhatian paling besar.

segments.src: - The jobs report shows how tight the labor market remains, with wages as a key detail.
segments.tr: - Laporan pekerjaan menunjukkan seberapa ketat pasar tenaga kerja saat ini, dengan upah sebagai rincian utamanya.

segments.src: - Strong hiring paired with firm inflation would make further tightening more plausible.
segments.tr: - Perekrutan yang kuat berpadu dengan inflasi yang tinggi akan membuat pengetatan lebih lanjut menjadi lebih masuk akal.

segments.src: - Softer readings on both would strengthen the case for a pause.
segments.tr: - Angka yang lebih rendah pada keduanya akan memperkuat alasan untuk jeda kenaikan suku bunga.

segments.src: - Markets can be volatile around these releases, and first reactions do not always last.
segments.tr: - Pasar bisa menjadi volatil di sekitar rilis data ini, dan reaksi pertama tidak selalu bertahan lama.

segments.src: *Economic data are subject to revision, and forecasts can be wrong.
segments.tr: *Data ekonomi dapat mengalami revisi, dan prakiraan bisa saja keliru.

segments.src: Readers should consult official sources such as the Bureau of Economic Analysis and the Bureau of Labor Statistics for the latest figures, and a qualified professional for personal financial decisions.*
segments.tr: Pembaca harus berkonsultasi dengan sumber resmi seperti Bureau of Economic Analysis dan Bureau of Labor Statistics untuk mendapatkan angka terbaru, serta profesional yang berkualifikasi untuk keputusan keuangan pribadi.*

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the PCE Report
segments.tr: ## PCEレポートで注目すべき点

segments.src: Policymakers have said they favor PCE over the better-known Consumer Price Index (CPI).
segments.tr: 政策当局者は、より広く知られている消費者物価指数（CPI）よりもPCEを好むと述べている。

segments.src: PCE covers a broader range of spending and adjusts as consumers change what they buy when prices rise.
segments.tr: PCEはより広範な支出をカバーし、価格上昇時に消費者が購入品目を変える行動にも適応する。

segments.src: Key details to look for:
segments.tr: 確認すべき主要な詳細：

segments.src: 1. **Headline vs. core.** Headline PCE includes food and energy. Core PCE leaves them out because they swing widely from month to month. Officials tend to focus on core as a guide to underlying trends.
segments.tr: 1. **総合 vs. コア。** 総合PCEには食品とエネルギーが含まれる。コアPCEは、月ごとの変動が大きいためこれらを除外している。当局者は基調的なトレンドの目安としてコアに注目する傾向がある。

segments.src: 2. **Month-over-month change.** A small monthly reading can suggest progress. A rebound can raise concern about how sticky inflation is.
segments.tr: 2. **前月比の変化。** 月次データが小さければ、進展を示唆する可能性がある。反発すれば、インフレのしぶとさに対する懸念を高めることになり得る。

segments.src: 3. **Services inflation.** Categories such as housing and healthcare have been slower to ease than goods prices. A steady decline here would be a meaningful sign.
segments.tr: 3. **サービスインフレ。** 住居費や医療費などのカテゴリーは、財の価格に比べて鈍化のペースが遅い。ここで着実な下落が見られれば意味のある兆候となる。

segments.src: 4. **Personal income and spending.** These figures show whether households are still spending freely or pulling back.
segments.tr: 4. **個人所得と支出。** これらの数値は、家計が依然として自由に支出しているのか、あるいは切り詰めているのかを示している。

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the Jobs Report
segments.tr: ## 雇用統計で注目すべき点

segments.src: The September employment report includes several numbers, and the headline job count is only one of them.
segments.tr: 9月の雇用報告には複数の数値が含まれており、全体の雇用者数の伸びはそのうちの1つに過ぎない。

segments.src: - **Payroll growth.** Strong gains suggest continued demand for workers. A sharp slowdown could point to cooling momentum.
segments.tr: - **雇用者数の伸び。** 力強い増加は、労働者の継続的な需要を示唆する。急激な減速は、勢いの低下を指し示す可能性がある。

segments.src: - **Unemployment rate.** A small change in this rate can shift expectations about the economy.
segments.tr: - **失業率。** この率のわずかな変化でも、経済に対する見方を大きく変えることがある。

segments.src: - **Average hourly earnings.** Fast wage growth can add to inflation pressure, particularly in service industries.
segments.tr: - **平均時給。** 急速な賃金上昇はインフレ圧力を高める要因となり得、特にサービス業においてそれが顕著である。

segments.src: - **Revisions.** Changes to prior months' figures can alter the picture as much as the new data.
segments.tr: - **改定値。** 過去数カ月の数値の修正は、新しいデータと同じくらい状況を一変させる可能性がある。

segments.src: ## How the Data Could Be Read
segments.tr: ## データがどのように読み解かれるか

segments.src: Economists often describe a few broad outcomes.
segments.tr: エコノミストたちは、いくつかの大まかなシナリオを描くことが多い。

segments.src: None is certain.

segments.tr: | 加熱 | 上振れ | 雇用の伸びが力強い | さらなる引き締めの可能性が高まる |

segments.src: ## Why Markets React

segments.src: Interest rate expectations affect many asset prices.
segments.tr: 金利の予想は多くの資産価格に影響を与える。

segments.src: Bond yields, the dollar, stock valuations and mortgage rates can all move on a single data release.
segments.tr: 債券利回り、ドル、株価評価、そして住宅ローン金利のすべてが、単一のデータ発表によって変動する可能性がある。

segments.src: Traders often adjust their views within minutes, and the early reaction can reverse as analysts look more closely at the details.

segments.src: Some investors treat a single report with caution and prefer to look at trends over several months.
segments.tr: 一部の投資家は単一のレポートに対して慎重な姿勢をとり、数カ月にわたるトレンドを見ることを好む。

segments.src: ## What It Means for Everyday Households
segments.tr: ## 一般家庭にとっての意味

segments.src: Fed decisions can reach ordinary budgets in several ways:
segments.tr: FRBの決定は、さまざまな形で個人の家計に影響を及ぼす：

segments.src: - **Borrowing costs.** Credit card rates, auto loans and home equity lines often follow the Fed's benchmark rate.
segments.tr: - **借入コスト。** クレジットカードの金利、自動車ローン、住宅担保融資（HELOC）は、多くの場合FRBの政策金利に連動する。

segments.src: - **Mortgages.** Rates are tied more closely to longer-term Treasury yields, but they respond to rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **住宅ローン。** 金利は長期の米国債利回りとより密接に結びついているが、金利の動向予測にも反応する。

segments.src: - **Savings.** Higher rates have generally meant better yields on savings accounts and certificates of deposit.
segments.tr: - **貯蓄。** 金利の上昇は一般的に、預金口座や定期預金の利回り向上の意味を持つ。

segments.src: - **Jobs and wages.** Tighter policy is meant to slow demand, which can affect hiring over time.
segments.tr: - **雇用と賃金。** 引き締め政策は需要を抑制することを目的としており、時間が経つにつれて採用活動に影響を与える可能性がある。

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## より大きな視点

segments.src: Officials will also weigh other information, including CPI, business surveys, consumer spending and global conditions.

segments.src: Still, this week's releases fall at a time when investors are looking for signs of where policy is headed.
segments.tr: それでもなお、今週の発表は、投資家が政策の向かう先についての兆候を探している時期に行われる。

segments.src: That is why they are drawing so much attention.
segments.tr: それゆえに、これほど多くの注目を集めているのである。

segments.src: ## Key Takeaways
segments.tr: ## 主な要点

segments.tr: Zwei der am strebend beobachteten Wirtschaftsdaten des Jahres erscheinen nur wenige Tage nacheinander.

segments.src: The Personal Consumption Expenditures (PCE) price index, the Federal Reserve's preferred inflation gauge, and the September jobs report will both be published this week.
segments.tr: Der Preisindex für die persönlichen Konsumausgaben (PCE), das von der Federal Reserve bevorzugte Inflationsbarometer, und der Arbeitsmarktbericht für September werden beide in dieser Woche veröffentlicht.

segments.src: Together they give investors, businesses and households their clearest look yet at whether the central bank is likely to keep raising interest rates into the new year or to hold steady.
segments.tr: Gemeinsam geben sie Investoren, Unternehmen und Haushalten den bislang klarsten Einblick, ob die Zentralbank die Zinsen im neuen Jahr voraussichtlich weiter anheben oder konstant halten wird.

segments.src: ## Why These Two Reports Matter Together
segments.tr: ## Warum diese beiden Berichte zusammen wichtig sind

segments.src: The Fed has a dual mandate: stable prices and maximum employment.
segments.tr: Die Fed hat ein duales Mandat: Preisstabilität und maximale Beschäftigung.

segments.src: Each report speaks to one half of it.
segments.tr: Jeder Bericht spricht eine Hälfte davon an.

segments.src: - **PCE inflation** shows whether price pressures are cooling toward the Fed's 2% target.
segments.tr: - **PCE-Inflation** zeigt, ob sich der Preisdruck in Richtung des 2%-Ziels der Fed abkühlt.

segments.src: - **Nonfarm payrolls** show whether the labor market is still running hot enough to keep wages and spending elevated.
segments.tr: - **Beschäftigungsdaten außerhalb der Landwirtschaft** zeigen, ob der Arbeitsmarkt noch heiß genug läuft, um Löhne und Ausgaben hoch zu halten.

segments.src: Either report alone can be read in more than one way.
segments.tr: Jeder Bericht für sich allein kann auf mehr als eine Weise interpretiert werden.

segments.src: Read side by side, they help show whether the economy is cooling in an orderly way or whether inflation risks remain.
segments.tr: Nebeneinander gelesen tragen sie dazu bei, zu zeigen, ob sich die Wirtschaft in geordneter Weise abkühlt oder ob Inflationsrisiken bestehen bleiben.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the PCE Report
segments.tr: ## Worauf im PCE-Bericht zu achten ist

segments.src: Policymakers have said they favor PCE over the better-known Consumer Price Index (CPI).
segments.tr: Die politischen Entscheidungsträger haben erklärt, dass sie den PCE dem bekannteren Verbraucherpreisindex (VPI) vorziehen.

segments.src: PCE covers a broader range of spending and adjusts as consumers change what they buy when prices rise.
segments.tr: Der PCE deckt ein breiteres Spektrum an Ausgaben ab und passt sich an, wenn Verbraucher ihr Kaufverhalten bei steigenden Preisen ändern.

segments.src: Key details to look for:
segments.tr: Wichtige Details, auf die zu achten ist:

segments.src: 1. **Headline vs. core.** Headline PCE includes food and energy. Core PCE leaves them out because they swing widely from month to month. Officials tend to focus on core as a guide to underlying trends.
segments.tr: 1. **Gesamt- vs. Kerninflation.** Die Gesamt-PCE enthält Lebensmittel und Energie. Die Kern-PCE lässt diese außen vor, da sie von Monat zu Monat stark schwanken. Offizielle Stellen neigen dazu, sich als Leitfaden für zugrundeliegende Trends auf den Kern zu konzentrieren.

segments.src: 2. **Month-over-month change.** A small monthly reading can suggest progress. A rebound can raise concern about how sticky inflation is.
segments.tr: 2. **Monatliche Veränderung.** Ein kleiner monatlicher Wert kann Fortschritte signalisieren. Eine Erholung kann Bedenken hinsichtlich der Hartnäckigkeit der Inflation aufwerfen.

segments.src: 3. **Services inflation.** Categories such as housing and healthcare have been slower to ease than goods prices. A steady decline here would be a meaningful sign.
segments.tr: 3. **Dienstleistungsinflation.** Kategorien wie Wohnen und Gesundheitswesen haben sich langsamer abgeschwächt als die Preise für Güter. Ein stetiger Rückgang hier wäre ein aussagekräftiges Zeichen.

segments.src: 4. **Personal income and spending.** These figures show whether households are still spending freely or pulling back.
segments.tr: 4. **Persönliches Einkommen und Konsum.** Diese Zahlen zeigen, ob die Haushalte weiterhin frei ausgeben oder sich zurückhalten.

segments.src: ## What to Watch in the Jobs Report
segments.tr: ## Worauf im Arbeitsmarktbericht zu achten ist

segments.src: The September employment report includes several numbers, and the headline job count is only one of them.
segments.tr: Der Beschäftigungsbericht für September enthält mehrere Zahlen, und die Gesamtzahl der Arbeitsplätze ist nur eine davon.

segments.src: - **Payroll growth.** Strong gains suggest continued demand for workers. A sharp slowdown could point to cooling momentum.
segments.tr: - **Beschäftigungswachstum.** Starke Zuwächse deuten auf eine anhaltende Nachfrage nach Arbeitskräften hin. Eine scharfe Verlangsamung könnte auf eine abkühlende Dynamik hinweisen.

segments.src: - **Unemployment rate.** A small change in this rate can shift expectations about the economy.
segments.tr: - **Arbeitslosenquote.** Eine geringe Änderung dieser Rate kann die Erwartungen an die Wirtschaft verändern.

segments.src: - **Average hourly earnings.** Fast wage growth can add to inflation pressure, particularly in service industries.
segments.tr: - **Durchschnittliche Stundenlöhne.** Ein schnelles Lohnwachstum kann den Inflationsdruck verstärken, insbesondere in der Dienstleistungsbranche.

segments.src: - **Revisions.** Changes to prior months' figures can alter the picture as much as the new data.
segments.tr: - **Revisionen.** Änderungen der Zahlen aus Vormonaten können das Bild ebenso verändern wie die neuen Daten.

segments.tr: ## Wie die Daten interpretiert werden könnten

segments.tr: Ökonomen beschreiben oft einige breite Ergebnisse.

segments.src: ## Why Markets React
segments.tr: ## Warum die Märkte reagieren

segments.src: Interest rate expectations affect many asset prices.
segments.tr: Zinserwartungen beeinflussen viele Vermögenspreise.

segments.src: Bond yields, the dollar, stock valuations and mortgage rates can all move on a single data release.
segments.tr: Anleiherenditen, der Dollar, Aktienbewertungen und Hypothekenzinsen können sich alle bei einer einzigen Datenveröffentlichung bewegen.

segments.src: Traders often adjust their views within minutes, and the early reaction can reverse as analysts look more closely at the details.
segments.tr: Händler passen ihre Ansichten oft innerhalb von Minuten an, und die frühe Reaktion kann sich umkehren, wenn Analysten die Details genauer betrachten.

segments.src: Some investors treat a single report with caution and prefer to look at trends over several months.
segments.tr: Einige Anleger behandeln einen einzelnen Bericht mit Vorsicht und betrachten lieber Trends über mehrere Monate hinweg.

segments.src: ## What It Means for Everyday Households
segments.tr: ## Was es für alltägliche Haushalte bedeutet

segments.src: Fed decisions can reach ordinary budgets in several ways:
segments.tr: Die Entscheidungen der Fed können normale Budgets auf verschiedene Weise erreichen:

segments.src: - **Borrowing costs.** Credit card rates, auto loans and home equity lines often follow the Fed's benchmark rate.
segments.tr: - **Kreditkosten.** Kreditkartenzinsen, Autokredite und Eigenheimkredite folgen oft dem Leitzins der Fed.

segments.src: - **Mortgages.** Rates are tied more closely to longer-term Treasury yields, but they respond to rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **Hypotheken.** Die Zinsen sind enger an längerfristige US-Staatsanleihen gekoppelt, reagieren jedoch auf Zinserwartungen.

segments.src: - **Savings.** Higher rates have generally meant better yields on savings accounts and certificates of deposit.
segments.tr: - **Ersparnisse.** Höhere Zinsen haben im Allgemeinen bessere Renditen auf Sparkonten und Einlagenzertifikate bedeutet.

segments.src: - **Jobs and wages.** Tighter policy is meant to slow demand, which can affect hiring over time.
segments.tr: - **Arbeitsplätze und Löhne.** Eine strengere Politik soll die Nachfrage dämpfen, was die Einstellung im Laufe der Zeit beeinflussen kann.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Das größere Bild

segments.src: The Fed has said its decisions depend on incoming data, so no single report is likely to settle the question.
segments.tr: Die Fed hat erklärt, dass ihre Entscheidungen von eingehenden Daten abhängen, sodass wahrscheinlich kein einzelner Bericht die Frage klären wird.

segments.src: Officials will also weigh other information, including CPI, business surveys, consumer spending and global conditions.
segments.tr: Die Beamten werden auch andere Informationen abwägen, darunter VPI, Unternehmensumfragen, Konsumausgaben und globale Bedingungen.

segments.src: Still, this week's releases fall at a time when investors are looking for signs of where policy is headed.
segments.tr: Dennoch fallen die Veröffentlichungen dieser Woche in eine Zeit, in der Anleger nach Anzeichen dafür suchen, wohin sich die Politik entwickelt.

segments.src: That is why they are drawing so much attention.
segments.tr: Deshalb erregen sie so viel Aufmerksamkeit.

segments.tr: ## Die wichtigsten Erkenntnisse

segments.tr: - Der PCE ist das bevorzugte Inflationsmaß der Fed, und der Kernwert erhält die meiste Aufmerksamkeit.

segments.src: - The jobs report shows how tight the labor market remains, with wages as a key detail.

segments.src: - Strong hiring paired with firm inflation would make further tightening more plausible.
segments.tr: - Eine starke Beschäftigung gepaart mit einer festen Inflation würde eine weitere Straffung plausibler machen.

segments.src: - Softer readings on both would strengthen the case for a pause.
segments.tr: - Schwächere Werte bei beiden würden das Argument für eine Pause stärken.

segments.src: - Markets can be volatile around these releases, and first reactions do not always last.
segments.tr: - Märkte können um diese Veröffentlichungen herum volatil sein, und erste Reaktionen halten nicht immer an.

segments.tr: ## Ý nghĩa đối với các hộ gia đình hàng ngày

segments.src: Fed decisions can reach ordinary budgets in several ways:
segments.tr: Các quyết định của Fed có thể tác động đến ngân sách thông thường theo nhiều cách:

segments.src: - **Borrowing costs.** Credit card rates, auto loans and home equity lines often follow the Fed's benchmark rate.
segments.tr: - **Chi phí đi vay.** Lãi suất thẻ tín dụng, khoản vay ô tô và hạn mức tín dụng Home Equity thường đi theo lãi suất chuẩn của Fed.

segments.src: - **Mortgages.** Rates are tied more closely to longer-term Treasury yields, but they respond to rate expectations.
segments.tr: - **Lãi suất thế chấp.** Lãi suất gắn kết chặt chẽ hơn với lợi suất Trái phiếu kho bạc kỳ hạn dài, nhưng chúng phản ứng với kỳ vọng lãi suất.

segments.src: - **Savings.** Higher rates have generally meant better yields on savings accounts and certificates of deposit.
segments.tr: - **Tiết kiệm.** Lãi suất cao hơn thường có nghĩa là lợi suất tốt hơn trên tài khoản tiết kiệm và chứng chỉ tiền gửi.

segments.src: - **Jobs and wages.** Tighter policy is meant to slow demand, which can affect hiring over time.
segments.tr: - **Việc làm và tiền lương.** Chính sách thắt chặt nhằm làm chậm nhu cầu, có thể ảnh hưởng đến việc tuyển dụng theo thời gian.

segments.src: ## The Bigger Picture
segments.tr: ## Bức tranh lớn hơn

segments.src: The Fed has said its decisions depend on incoming data, so no single report is likely to settle the question.
segments.tr: Fed đã cho biết các quyết định của họ phụ thuộc vào dữ liệu sắp tới, vì vậy không có báo cáo đơn lẻ nào có khả năng giải quyết vấn đề này.

segments.src: Officials will also weigh other information, including CPI, business surveys, consumer spending and global conditions.
segments.tr: Các quan chức cũng sẽ cân nhắc các thông tin khác, bao gồm CPI, khảo sát doanh nghiệp, chi tiêu tiêu dùng và điều kiện toàn cầu.

segments.src: Still, this week's releases fall at a time when investors are looking for signs of where policy is headed.
segments.tr: Tuy nhiên, các đợt phát hành tuần này diễn ra vào thời điểm các nhà đầu tư đang tìm kiếm dấu hiệu về hướng đi của chính sách.

segments.src: That is why they are drawing so much attention.
segments.tr: Đó là lý do tại sao chúng thu hút được nhiều sự chú ý đến vậy.

segments.src: ## Key Takeaways
segments.tr: ## Điểm chính cần nắm

segments.src: - PCE is the Fed's preferred inflation measure, and the core reading gets the most attention.
segments.tr: - PCE là thước đo lạm phát ưa thích của Fed và số đọc cốt lõi nhận được nhiều sự chú ý nhất.

segments.src: - The jobs report shows how tight the labor market remains, with wages as a key detail.
segments.tr: - Báo cáo việc làm cho thấy thị trường lao động vẫn thắt chặt như thế nào, với tiền lương là một chi tiết chính.

segments.src: - Strong hiring paired with firm inflation would make further tightening more plausible.
segments.tr: - Việc tuyển dụng mạnh mẽ đi kèm với lạm phát cứng rắn sẽ làm cho việc thắt chặt thêm trở nên hợp lý hơn.

segments.src: - Softer readings on both would strengthen the case for a pause.
segments.tr: - Các chỉ số dịu hơn trên cả hai sẽ củng cố lập luận cho việc tạm dừng.

segments.src: - Markets can be volatile around these releases, and first reactions do not always last.
segments.tr: - Thị trường có thể biến động xung quanh các đợt phát hành này và phản ứng đầu tiên không phải lúc nào cũng kéo dài.

segments.src: *Economic data are subject to revision, and forecasts can be wrong.
segments.tr: *Dữ liệu kinh tế có thể bị sửa đổi và dự báo có thể sai.

segments.src: Readers should consult official sources such as the Bureau of Economic Analysis and the Bureau of Labor Statistics for the latest figures, and a qualified professional for personal financial decisions.*
segments.tr: Độc giả nên tham khảo các nguồn chính thức như Cục Phân tích Kinh tế và Cục Thống kê Lao động để có các số liệu mới nhất, và một chuyên gia đủ điều kiện cho các quyết định tài chính cá nhân.*
